D/ CONSTAN[---]P[--] ; R/ GLORI A EXERC[ITVS]

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Constantine, Gloria Exercitus issue of 336-340, Reece period 17. Obverse description: Bust diademed and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: CONSTAN[---]P[--]. Reverse description: Two soldiers facing each other with one standard between them, a flag on standard bears the letter M. Reverse inscription: GLORI A EXERC[ITVS].
